title: Protection paladin: stuns a casting mob with Hammer of Justice within 3 s

rules.desc: The Protection paladin casts Hammer of Justice on the mob within 3 s of an interruptible cast start, at least 60 percent of the time, pooled over the repeats (one trigger per mob per 10 s, one counted answer per 60 s: Hammer of Justice has a 60 s cooldown, so each repeat answers only a few casts and the trigger minimum is read on the pooled total)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:373-379 (protection cc: hammer of justice on enemy at ACTION_INTERRUPT); ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinStrategy.cpp:339-341 (PaladinCcStrategy: hammer of justice interrupt at ACTION_INTERRUPT); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the stun answers the cast but its 60 s cooldown means the bot can only catch about one cast a minute, and the 60 s responder debounce leaves 1-2 triggers per repeat: those triggers pool over the repeats (TNK-PAL-HOJ AFTER t1113: 2/5 answered per repeat, INCONCLUSIVE per rep at min_n 3). Expected at abb91ff62 if the pooled share stays under 0.6, the misses being the first cast right after a cooldown expiry

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently at abb91ff62.
